name: Differentiable Voxelization (MC/CF)
definition: A PyTorch autograd function that voxelizes a 2D polygon or 3D triangle mesh into a grid of winding numbers, supporting both Marching Cubes (mc) and Convolution Filter (cf) methods with differentiable backward passes.
summary: Differentiable Voxelization rasterizes meshes into occupancy grids using closed-form analytic gradients, distinguishing itself from Monte Carlo and analytic moment methods.
